coverLetter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior PHP Developer position at your Home & Living Boulevard. With 7+ years of experience building scalable PHP systems—including ERP-like platforms, warehouse management integrations, and high-traffic e-commerce architectures—I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your technical transformation from legacy systems to a modern Symfony-based stack.

At BSE America, I architected an end-to-end CRM system with ERP functionality, including inventory management, automated invoicing, and third-party integrations using Laravel and SOLID design principles. I implemented CI/CD pipelines and AWS infrastructure that reduced deployment times by 80%, while mentoring developers to improve code review approval rates from 40% to 85%. This experience directly aligns with your need for someone who can modernize systems while elevating engineering standards.

During my time at First Due, I worked on a multi-tenant SaaS platform serving 40+ enterprise clients using PHP (Yii 2) and PostgreSQL. I designed RESTful APIs and optimized database queries handling 5,000+ daily transactions, contributing to the platform's scalability and reliability—skills that translate perfectly to your high-traffic e-commerce environment.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of the opportunity to work on meaningful architectural decisions during your platform modernization journey. I thrive in environments where I can bridge legacy systems with modern practices, and I enjoy coaching colleagues to build sustainable, scalable solutions. Your focus on professionalization and growth aligns with my career goals.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my PHP expertise, architectural experience, and collaborative approach can support your team's mission to build the best home & living webshop in the Netherlands.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to connecting.
